nodes.description: Constructor of LoveCoin; mints the entire initial supply of 21,000,000 LOV to the deployer (_msgSender).
External batch transfer function; iterates over recipients/values arrays and calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipients[i], values[i]) for each entry.
Internal ERC20 transfer routine; decrements sender balance, increments recipient balance via SafeMath and emits Transfer.
Internal ERC20 mint routine; increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account] using SafeMath.add.
Private mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private uint256 tracking the total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender(); used as mint beneficiary in the constructor and as the source of funds in transferMany.
Calldata array of destination addresses supplied by the caller to transferMany.
Calldata array of token amounts supplied by the caller to transferMany, indexed in parallel with recipients.
Loop counter of transferMany, bounded by recipients.length which is fully caller-controlled.
Unbounded loop that repeatedly invokes _transfer; array length is attacker-controlled, enabling gas exhaustion / denial of service and repeated unchecked state writes.
Arithmetic mutation of _balances via SafeMath sub/add; the caller-supplied amount is the operands of these state-changing computations.

edges.reason: constructor executes _mint(_msgSender(), 21 * 10**6 * 10**18) to create the initial supply.
constructor passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the mint beneficiary, so the caller controls the privileged initial allocation.
msg.sender flows through _msgSender() into _mint as the account whose balance is credited.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add(amount), a state-changing arithmetic operation.
transferMany uses _msgSender() as the fixed source address, so the caller determines which balance is debited.
transferMany enters an unbounded for-loop over the caller-supplied recipients array.
each loop iteration calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipients[i], values[i]).
recipients array length and contents drive the loop bound and destination addresses.
values array is validated against recipients.length and drives the loop body.
loop counter i indexes both calldata arrays on every iteration.
recipients[i] is forwarded as the recipient argument of _transfer, crediting attacker-chosen addresses.
values[i] is forwarded as the amount argument of _transfer, controlling the transferred quantity.
_transfer performs sub/add arithmetic on balances with the caller-supplied amount.
the SafeMath sub/add results are written back into the _balances mapping.
_transfer reads and writes _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient] for every batch element.

normalization_plan.reason: recipients is a calldata parameter of transferMany; its length is the loop bound and its elements are forwarded to _transfer, so it should be folded into the enclosing transferMany core function.
values is a calldata parameter of transferMany validated against recipients.length; it is consumed only inside the transferMany loop and should be folded into that core function.
i is the local loop counter of transferMany; it has no independent semantic identity and should be merged into the transferMany core function node.
